meta.title: 原图VS精修：小姐姐底子很好，稍稍修一点更精致
meta.title_en: From Original to Retouch: a Little Goes a Long Way

scenes.context: 蓝色锚点路径贴着下颌线移动，为轮廓选择或修整做准备。修图第一步是锁定需要调整的区域。
sentences: 蓝色锚点路径贴着下颌线。
A blue anchor path hugs the jawline.
准备做轮廓相关选择或修整。
Ready for contour-related selection or retouching.
paraphrase: A blue anchor path hugs the jawline.
Ready for contour-related selection or retouching.
scenes.speak: A blue anchor path hugs the jawline. Ready for contour-related selection or retouching.

scenes.context: 红底、白蕾丝裙与头纱、俯视表情一并入镜，先从整体看画面再动手。
sentences: The 3D mode gives an overall view.
红底白裙头纱一起入镜。
Red backdrop, white dress and veil in one shot.
paraphrase: The 3D mode gives an overall view.
用in one shot换一种说法
Red backdrop, white dress and veil in one shot.
scenes.speak: The 3D mode gives an overall view. Red backdrop, white dress and veil in one shot.

scenes.context: 颈部横纹被圈选，扩散=5，准备做局部清理或生成式修补。细碎瑕疵要局部处理。
sentences: The neck's horizontal lines are selected.
用局部清理或生成式修补。
Use local cleanup or generative healing.
paraphrase: The neck's horizontal lines are selected.
Use local cleanup or generative healing.
scenes.speak: The neck's horizontal lines are selected. Use local cleanup or generative healing.

scenes.context: 液化/变形网格压在颊颌上，微调脸型轮廓。「颜值修图」水印可见。
sentences: A liquify grid presses over the cheek and jaw.
paraphrase: A liquify grid presses over the cheek and jaw.
scenes.speak: A liquify grid presses over the cheek and jaw. Gently refine the face contour.

scenes.context: 钢笔路径落在蕾丝与捧花附近，继续做精准选择。复杂边缘靠钢笔抠图。
sentences: 钢笔路径落在蕾丝附近。
The pen path lands near the lace and bouquet.
paraphrase: The pen path lands near the lace and bouquet.
scenes.speak: The pen path lands near the lace and bouquet. Continue the precise selection.

scenes.context: 左侧工具条齐全，圆形笔刷落在颈部，做肤质修复。笔刷修复让皮肤更均匀。
sentences: A round brush works on the neck.
paraphrase: A round brush works on the neck.
scenes.speak: A round brush works on the neck. Repairing the skin texture.

scenes.context: 「选择并遮住」视图：检查全身轮廓与边缘是否干净。这一步决定抠图边缘质量。
sentences: 检查轮廓边缘是否干净。
Check if the outline edges are clean.
paraphrase: 用Select and Mask换一种说法
Check if the outline edges are clean.
scenes.speak: The Select and Mask view. Check if the outline edges are clean.

scenes.context: 额头散落发丝被圈选，扩散=5，继续做细碎清理。碎发清理让画面更干净。
scenes.speak: Stray forehead hairs are selected. Continuing the fine cleanup.

practice: 看到颈部横纹，你要怎么圈选出来？
Select the neck's horizontal lines to clean them up.
修图前先整体看一遍画面，用英语怎么说？
Take an overall look at the shot before you start.
用笔刷修复肤质，怎么说？
Use a round brush to repair the skin texture.
检查轮廓边缘是否干净。
Check if the outline edges are clean.
pitfalls: 看到颈部横纹就直接磨皮整片处理
只圈选横纹局部、用生成式修补
局部处理保留肤质，整片磨皮会失真
液化时大幅度推动下颌
液化网格轻推、幅度要小
大幅度推动会让脸型失真不自然
先3D模式整体审视画面再动手
从整体出发才不会顾此失彼
跳过边缘检查直接导出
用「选择并遮住」检查边缘
shifts: 先圈选、做局部生成式修补
